name: Texas
agency: Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS), Driver License Division
permitAge: 15 (learner license, ages 15 to 17), after the classroom phase of driver education and the knowledge test

teen.nightLimit: Provisional license under 18: no driving midnight to 5 a.m. unless for work, a school-related activity or a medical emergency
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional license under 18: no more than one passenger under 21 who is not a family member
teen.phone: Drivers under 18: no wireless communication device at all, hands-free included, except in an emergency. All drivers: texting banned statewide since 2017; no hand-held phone in an active school zone.

notes: Learner license supervisor: licensed, at least 21, at least one year of driving experience, in the seat beside the driver (Transp. Code 521.222).
Knowledge test pass mark 70 percent; offered in English and Spanish only (37 TAC 15.52). Number of questions is not published by DPS; commercial sites say 30.
Impact Texas Teen Drivers (ITTD) video course within 90 days before the road test (secondary).

Move over / slow down (Transp. Code 545.157): vacate the lane closest to the stopped vehicle, or slow to 20 mph below the limit; 5 mph when the limit is 25 or less. Since Sept. 1, 2025 also covers animal control and parking enforcement vehicles (TxDOT).

School bus (Transp. Code 545.066): opposite-direction traffic need not stop only on separate roadways (intervening space or physical barrier); a center left-turn lane does not count. First offense fine $500 to $1,250.
Urban district prima facie limit 30 mph; 70 mph on numbered highways outside urban districts (Transp. Code 545.352); higher limits by order on some roads, not used in questions.
Spanish handbook DL-7S is listed on the DPS forms index (https://www.dps.texas.gov/InternetForms/Home/SectionDetails/15); direct PDF URL not confirmed.
